name: BAM-15
lead: BAM15 is an experimental mitochondrial uncoupler, a small molecule that lets protons leak across the inner mitochondrial membrane so that nutrient oxidation produces heat rather than ATP. It was identified in a 2014 screen as an uncoupler that did not depolarize the plasma membrane.[1]

In mice fed a high-fat diet, oral BAM15 reduced body fat and improved insulin sensitivity without changing food intake in studies reported in 2020.[3][4] Wikipedia notes no human trials.[10] It is discussed in fat-loss communities as a possible alternative to the older uncoupler DNP; no published human data support its use for that purpose.

paras: Uncouplers raise energy expenditure by dissipating the proton gradient used to make ATP.[1] BAM15 was reported to uncouple mitochondria without depolarizing the cell's plasma membrane, a property that distinguishes it from older uncouplers.[1] A 2020 mouse study described it as orally bioavailable.[3]

In diet-induced obese mice, BAM15 decreased fat mass and improved glycemic control.[3][4] It was reported to improve muscle quality in a sarcopenic obesity model,[5] and to reduce mortality and kidney injury in mouse sepsis[6] and inflammation in a mouse endotoxin model.[9] These are animal findings.

Users on looksmaxxing forums discuss BAM15 as a fat-loss compound and compare it with DNP, a uncoupler with documented fatal toxicity. These are anecdotal accounts; no clinical safety data exist for BAM15 in people.

card.summary: A mitochondrial uncoupler that burns fat in mice and is traded online as a 'safer DNP'; no human data exist.
card.note: No human safety data; uncoupling class has documented toxicity.

quick.overview:
BAM15 is an experimental compound that makes mitochondria burn fuel as heat. In mice it cut fat mass and improved blood sugar.

Forum users discuss it as an alternative to DNP, but no human trials have been published.
quick.mechanism: It carries protons across the mitochondrial membrane, uncoupling food oxidation from ATP production and raising energy expenditure.
quick.risks: Human safety is unstudied. Uncouplers as a class can cause overheating, and DNP has been linked to fatal poisonings. BAM15 is not approved.
